race.comment: KICKOFF (4) has the right blend of current form and race fitness, having won a BM55 at this track before being beaten a nose in a BM60 here as favourite. She comes in lighter, draws well and has enough local form to be treated as the one to beat. CHARTWELL (1) is the clear danger after a BM70 win at this track and a close Class 5 third behind Metalcraft. Key runner. FABULEAN (6) has been close up in successive runs at Mackay and Bowen, gets Sean Cormack back aboard and is well proven at 1200m. LOOMING ONE (9) has found form at this venue, winning last start after a narrow second, but both recent peaks came at BM55 level. Genuine each-way threat.
